title: FactoryOps Quality Document 1
text: SOP-QA-017 requires immediate quarantine, supplier notification, traceability review and an 8D response within 24 hours for critical safety deviations.

title: FMEA Brake Pressure Sensor
text: FMEA: brake pressure sensor dimensional deviation may cause calibration risk. Containment includes quarantine, traceability and verification.

title: 8D Supplier Response Template
text: 8D requires root-cause analysis, corrective action ownership and effectiveness verification for supplier quality escapes.

title: QS-100 Incoming Quality Standard
text: Quality Standard: incoming dimensional anomalies require a failed inspection result and controlled batch containment.

title: Fictional Supplier Switching Review SOP
text: DEMONSTRATION POLICY: Before switching an automotive brake sensor supplier, review part compatibility, approved qualification, capacity and delivery commitments, assess common upstream dependencies and affected vehicle platforms, and record human approval. Approval creates a review task and does not replace PPAP validation or release purchase orders.
